note: 170 acres on a long dead-end road off I-71; the interstate is audible in places. Grass-and-gravel sites, some not level; low limbs on the park roads. --Claude
summary: Posted $35-45 confirmed (undated page); Good Sam Park added (reported); engine live; pin 370 m off at the entrance; ponds, not a lake; mostly seasonal per a camper.
flags: GATE: passes on the posted $35 (full hookup) / $45 (pull-through), though the page has no year and its footer says 2020. Passport America' on a pull-through. Google 4.1 over 169 reviews.

REVIEWS, middling: 8/2026 motorhome 'okay as a one night stay ... The sites were not level. Combination of grass and gravel ... Park is very large and appeared to be mostly' [text cut off by RV Life's API]; 7/2026 'Bathrooms are just OK not super clean but not dirty either'; 9/2026 'Pay attention to the tree limbs ... clean up the front entrance'; favourable 8/2026 'Super wide RV spots, very long >60 ft pull thru sites' and 9/2026 'Nice, secluded park' (second stay).

LONG-STAY (test 4): the operator says 'a campground for Families, Travelers and Seasonal Campers', and sells $2,300 seasons. Share not posted; imagery shows the loops west of the office as long-established units with the open pull-through block east looking transient. Test 2 passes on the posted nightly rate and the engine.

WATERFRONT RE-AUDIT LEAD (weak, upward): the operator's own wording is 'Great Fishing Ponds' with rules calling them 'the lake'/'the lakes'; stored not waterfront. Imagery (cloud patches on the only frame read) shows at least three ponds; the transient pull-through block is 100 m+ from them, but units in the west/north loops sit nearer the pond about 40.9615,-82.0695. Not plotted per site: there's no per-site data. Pond at best, for some seasonal-looking lots.

PIN: stored 40.96167,-82.07292 (and Google's) is the entrance at the end of Shilling Road. The sites' centre is about 40.9605,-82.0688, ~370 m ESE; the open pull-through block is about 40.9607,-82.0670.
